precedence: specific named canon for the entity or installation
authority.rule: A civilization, race, manufacturer, vessel, installation, inventor, date, prevalence statement, or historical ownership statement is bound to an FTL family only when an authoritative source actually establishes that relation. Machinery resemblance, technology basis, generated prevalence, or repeated examples are not evidence of ownership.

claim_model.admission_rule: Admit an externally asserted claim only when its source ancestry supports the claim, no higher-precedence authority contradicts it, and every non-source transformation is explicitly labeled.

explicit_evidence_required: licensed, captured, stolen, reverse-engineered, or inherited origin
permitted_bindings: confirmed named source directly identifies the relation
confirmed vessel or installation record explicitly names its drive family
confirmed manufacturer record explicitly names the product/family
derived machinery consequence from a confirmed family plus independently confirmed technology basis, with ownership left unchanged
proposed teaching example with all names/history explicitly fictional or unresolved
forbidden_inferences: same Q-space vocabulary makes Q-Lattice and Slipstream one family
captured hardware changes the originating family's physical operator
multiple descendants of one source count as independent confirmation

meaning.I_e: installation-specific geometry, power, thermal, control, structural, and maintenance constraints

variable_layers: structural load paths and protected-volume geometry
embodiment_model.rule: Embodiment may change how the same effect is generated, controlled, serviced, sensed, cooled, packaged, and detected; it may not silently replace the family operator with another physical mechanism.

provenance_model.graph: G_P = (V,E), where vertices are source or claim records and directed edges are extraction, normalization, derivation, proposal, inheritance, or contradiction relations.
provenance_model.independence_rule: Claims that share the same ultimate source ancestor are correlated evidence and cannot be counted as independent confirmations merely because they appear in separate files or generated records.

coverage_metric.scope: editorial/generated-record provenance completeness; not an in-world physical measurement

contradiction_policy.conflict_set: K(c) = { s_i | s_i supports a materially incompatible value of claim c }
resolution_order: test whether apparent conflict is embodiment-versus-operator rather than true contradiction
contradiction_policy.unresolved_rule: When materially incompatible top/equal-authority claims cannot be resolved by scope, revision, or explicit precedence, mark the contested field UNRESOLVED and retain the contradiction set. Do not average, majority-vote, or choose the more convenient value.

foreign_systems.rule: Keep physical family/operator provenance separate from current custodian, service doctrine, replacement parts, interfaces, and local modifications. Local integration does not rewrite origin.

multi_origin_vessels.rule: Track propulsion/FTL, power, navigation, sensors, control, cooling, structure, recovery, and reference authorities as independently provenance-bearing subsystems. A vessel may legitimately contain systems from several origins without becoming evidence that any one origin invented the others.

common_mode_dependencies.rule: A secondary or foreign drive is not independent merely because its prime mover is different; shared critical dependencies must appear in failure and survivability analysis.

return_to_service.rule: Unknown provenance or configuration changes remain explicit service limitations rather than being silently normalized.

engineering_domains.power: Civilization/manufacturer practice may alter generation, conditioning, buffering, distribution, redundancy, and reserve custody while preserving family-specific event/hold/recovery semantics.
engineering_domains.navigation_control: Interface philosophy, sensor carrier, compute architecture, automation and crew roles may vary; family-specific observables, commit boundaries, hard vetoes, and recovery requirements remain invariant unless higher canon says otherwise.
engineering_domains.maintenance: Service intervals, replaceable units, access, calibration tooling, diagnostic vocabulary and certification culture may vary. Diagnostic conclusions must still trace to the same physical failure classes.
engineering_domains.signature: Materials, cooling, shielding and operating doctrine may redistribute observable channels, but cannot erase operator-required phenomena without explicit higher authority.
engineering_domains.failure: Embodiment introduces additional implementation failures and common-mode dependencies; it cannot remove confirmed family failure modes by assertion.
engineering_domains.infrastructure: Local industry may change beacon, gate, service-yard, calibration, traffic-control and spares architecture; family-required infrastructure remains a hard requirement where established.
engineering_domains.scaling: Manufacturing quality and embodiment can improve coefficients and packaging, but family-specific nonlinear variables remain active. Better craftsmanship is not permission to linearize a confirmed scaling burden.

generation_rules.authority_only: Emit only bindings directly supported by admitted authoritative claims; unresolved entity/family relations stay unresolved.
generation_rules.labeled_derivation: May derive engineering consequences from confirmed family operator, independently supported technology basis and installation facts; every derived field keeps source ancestry and DERIVED status.
generation_rules.labeled_proposal: May construct hypothetical embodiments, manuals, teaching cases, patent classes or retrofit plans, but proposed names/history cannot be re-imported as canon without a new authoritative source.
generation_rules.determinism: Given the same authority snapshot, resolver version, inputs and seed where stochastic generation is permitted, claim admission and provenance output must be reproducible.

canon_guards: Established family physics outranks machinery resemblance.
Specific named canon outranks generic embodiment defaults.
Technology basis does not establish race, civilization, or manufacturer ownership.
Generated prevalence does not become setting prevalence.
Generated examples, training accidents, patent filings, theses, manuals, and fictional inventors remain at their declared status.
A captured, licensed, salvaged, reverse-engineered, or refitted system retains independently sourced origin provenance.
Multiple files descended from one source ancestor are not independent evidence.
Unknown inventor, date, manufacturer, civilization, race, ownership, or prevalence fields remain UNRESOLVED rather than being completed for narrative neatness.
Family-specific safety, gravity, commit, recovery, scaling, signature, and infrastructure constraints cannot be overwritten by civilization flavor text.
A proposed alien patent or educational history cannot recursively cite itself into canon.
Generated vessel-instance authority is scoped to that instance unless a higher setting authority explicitly generalizes it.
